children.highlighted: import { Component, inject, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { IonAvatar, IonButton, IonButtons, IonContent, IonHeader, IonIcon, IonItem, IonLabel, IonList, IonMenuToggle, IonModal, IonText, IonTitle, IonToolbar } from '@ionic/angular'; import { addIcons } from 'ionicons'; import { power } from 'ionicons/icons'; import { ZeldaService } from '../../services/zelda-service'; import { ZeldaMaterial } from '../../common/models/zelda.model'; import {MenuComponent} from "../../components/menu/menu.component"; import {ToastService} from "../../services/toast-service"; @Component({ standalone: true, selector: 'app-materials', templateUrl: './materials.page.html', styleUrls: ['./materials.page.scss'], imports: [ IonContent, IonHeader, IonTitle, IonToolbar, CommonModule, FormsModule, IonAvatar, IonButton, IonIcon, IonList, IonItem, IonLabel, IonMenuToggle, MenuComponent, IonModal, IonButtons, IonText, ], }) export class MaterialsPage implements OnInit { private readonly zeldaService: ZeldaService = inject(ZeldaService); private readonly toastService: ToastService = inject(ToastService); materials = signal<ZeldaMaterial[]>([]); randomNumber = signal<number>(0); constructor() { addIcons({ power }); } ngOnInit() { this.loadMaterials(); } private loadMaterials() { this.zeldaService.getZeldaMaterials().subscribe({ next: (res) => { this.materials.set(res.data); }, error: (err) => { console.error(err); }, }); } protected generateRandom() { this.randomNumber.set(Math.floor(Math.random() * this.materials().length)); } protected onWillDismiss(event: CustomEvent) { if (event.detail.role === 'cancel') { this.toastService.showToast('Cancelado','danger'); } if (event.detail.role === 'aceptar') { this.toastService.showToast('Aceptado: '+ this.materials()[this.randomNumber()].name,'primary'); } } }
